core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mahmood corresponds to the Arabic form محمود (Arabic root ح م د (ḥ-m-d); مَحْمُود (Maḥmūd)). Its core sense is praiseworthy, commendable. Mahmood is Arabic مَحْمُود (Maḥmūd) 'praiseworthy, commendable', from the root ح م د (ḥ-m-d); it is a well-documented male given name borne by the Ghaznavid sultan Mahmud of Ghazni. The source gloss 'Praiseworthy' is consistent. Same name as mahmoud, mahmud and mahmood.
